amendment_reason: Nearest-work Round B, run after the R3 mechanism became public but before confirmatory holdout materialization, found two materially stronger parents: R2Act (arXiv:2607.04623) evaluates diagnosis-to-valid recovery action and admissible target, while dependency-guided rollback repair (arXiv:2608.10502) traces propagated dependencies, preserves benign state and selectively replays affected computation. The strongest fair parent must therefore combine class-conditioned admissible repair with recursive dependency rollback. This absorbs post-diagnosis action selection and dependency recovery from ORION novelty. Because that composite should agree with ORION on ordinary intervention-backed repairs, the primary estimand is narrowed prospectively to the authority-critical subset where a plausible diagnosis-matching mutation exists but intervention-backed scientific permission is absent. Whole-grid repair/recovery/safety remain mandatory non-regression guards. No margin is relaxed and no confirmatory output exists.
unchanged: candidate residual: protected scientific K/W/M mutation authority
fresh holdout generator and confirmatory seed

components: dependency-guided recursive rollback/replay preserving unrelated state

primary_hypothesis.text: On the prospectively frozen authority-critical subset of the fresh holdout—mutation-bearing formulation/search-universe diagnoses with a plausible diagnosis-matching recovery proposal but no intervention-backed scientific permission—ORION typed permission plus dependency-scoped reopening improves scientifically-valid authority decisions by at least 20 percentage points over the frozen R2Act+dependency-rollback composite parent. Across the whole 384-task grid, ORION must remain non-inferior in scientifically-valid repair and root-task recovery, keep unauthorized epistemic mutation <=1%, and retain legitimate-repair recall within 2 percentage points.

authority_critical_subset.definition: diagnosis responsibility is FORMULATION or SEARCH_UNIVERSE; intervention_backed is false; at least one public proposal predicts root recovery and contains the diagnosis-matching mutation request; protected gold requires BLOCK/CANNOT_CHECK rather than mutation

matched_arms.description: Never mutate; safety-by-refusal floor that fails legitimate repair recall.
Apply any proposed repair predicted to restore the local task; no protected-coordinate or dependency guard.
Intervention-supported diagnosis-specific local patch; no scientific-authority lattice and no dependency propagation.
Diagnosis-specific local patch plus recursive downstream regeneration; no protected scientific mutation-authority gate.
Responsibility-class-conditioned smallest matching local repair plus direct dependency update; no intervention-backed authority predicate.

Strongest Round-B parent: diagnosis-conditioned admissible local repair/target plus recursive dependency rollback preserving unrelated state; intentionally omits ORION's protected scientific mutation-authority predicate.
ORION permission matrix filters proposed actions but dependency-scoped reopen is disabled.
Full candidate: protected ORION permission matrix plus recursive dependency-scoped reopening.
Same accepted local repair as ORION but invalidates every closure; measures over-reopening.
